output.format: single image, no text overlays added beyond what already exists
output.note: لو المطلوب ستوري أو ريلز بدّل إلى 1080x1920 (9:16) وأعد ترتيب النصّ رأسياً بنفس الكلمات.

preserve_exactly.arabic_text: identical wording, order, and line breaks
preserve_exactly.doctor_photo: same face, same pose, same crop
preserve_exactly.composition_logic: same visual hierarchy — headline, sub-line, photo, trust row

background.gradient: very soft, from base toward a translucent light blue in the top-right corner

accent.use: one thin element only — a divider rule or a dot

palette.rule: one colour dominates, the rest are accents; maximum three colours in the composition

attached_assets.clear_space: empty margin around it not less than its own height

attached_assets.role: the modonty trust shield — a navy shield outlined in cyan with the modonty m inside it; it means «verified partner on modonty»
attached_assets.placement: immediately beside the doctor or clinic name
attached_assets.size: about 1.2x the height of the text line it sits on
forbidden: replacing it with a check mark, ribbon, or any other symbol
flattening the shield into a circle or square

photo_treatment.subject: unchanged
photo_treatment.separation: very soft drop shadow instead of a hard frame
photo_treatment.edge: feather the edge so it blends into the light background

typography.hierarchy: by size and weight, never by colour alone
typography.min_readable_size: text must stay legible at 500px wide — that is how the ad is first seen on a phone feed

facebook_ad_rules.text_density: keep on-image text light — heavy text reduces delivery even though the old 20% rule was retired
facebook_ad_rules.safe_margins: keep every element at least 5% of the canvas away from all edges
facebook_ad_rules.thumbnail_test: the headline and the face must still read when the image is scaled to 250x250
forbidden: fake UI elements such as play buttons or notification badges
personal-attribute targeting language addressed to the viewer's condition

mood.principle: elegance comes from space and proportion, not from more colour

hard_constraints: do not reorder or reword the Arabic copy
do not add any new text
do not replace the trust shield with a check icon, circle, or ribbon — use the attached shield exactly
